compute_unit: One U is one 4096x4096 inference window including the calibrated service boundary
primary_metric: P300: all window results and target crops aggregated on the ground within 300 seconds of image readiness

calibration_report.purpose: Real Jetson service calibration of a fixed synthetic SAR computation proxy, for simulation parameter selection
calibration_report.compute_unit: One native-scale 4096x4096 window is one U

throughput_acceptance.meaning: Completed windows per 60 seconds over the last five complete bins; finite-run throughput stability, not thermal equilibrium

selection.rule: Use only complete iteration//64 cycles whose preceding sample completion is at/after the lower boundary and final completion is within the interval
selection.rounding: Ceiling to the next whole millisecond

aggregation.scope: CPU reference measurement on the recorded machine; not automatically a ground-server measurement
aggregation.measurement_boundary: Already-received bytes -> parse and copy previews -> global coordinates -> class-wise polygon NMS -> encode merged bytes

memory_budget_validation.meaning: Each observed CUDA peak and process RSS individually fits the proposed reservation; these overlapping/asynchronous metrics are not summed and do not prove joint physical peak usage
memory_budget_validation.shared_memory_budget: Simulation reserves 8 decimal GB for execution and 8 GB for queues within a nominal 32 GB shared-memory proxy; remaining 16 GB is a system/reserve assumption

calibration_report.measurement_boundary: host uint16 raster -> preprocessing -> CUDA transfer/normalization -> fused FP32 forward including head decode -> full decoded prediction to CPU -> controlled polygon NMS -> ROI preview and SRP1 encoding

startup_system_ram_reference.meaning: First controller telemetry sample during process startup; not a controlled idle or resident-model baseline

thermal_validation.frequency_stability: No GPU MHz samples: GR3D_FREQ utilization alone cannot establish frequency stability
thermal_validation.temperature_scope: Record finite-run sensor levels and trends; stable throughput does not prove complete thermal equilibrium
thermal_validation.extrapolation: No guarantee beyond the observed 15-minute sustained interval or under flight cooling and resource contention

telemetry.energy_scope: Power rails are preserved only in raw telemetry; no incremental energy or idle-subtracted power is inferred
telemetry.ram_scope: System-wide RAM includes other processes and shared allocations; reported MB labels are retained without summing CUDA allocation and process RSS
telemetry.time_alignment: UTC origin inferred from first sustained row completion minus its elapsed wall time; sub-millisecond alignment is not claimed

thermal_validation.frequency_stability: No GPU MHz samples: GR3D_FREQ utilization alone cannot establish frequency stability
thermal_validation.temperature_scope: Record finite-run sensor levels and trends; stable throughput does not prove complete thermal equilibrium
thermal_validation.extrapolation: No guarantee beyond the observed 15-minute sustained interval or under flight cooling and resource contention

limitations: Synthetic uint16 pixels and canonical controlled detections; no SAR image recognition accuracy or real harbor density estimate
Official optical YOLO11n-OBB is a computation proxy; optical predictions are discarded before controlled NMS
FP32 refers to tensor and parameter dtype; reported backend flags may allow TF32 for cuDNN
Active service excludes hashes, file/log IO and function-scope cleanup after the timer; it is not measured end-to-end wall throughput
One resident model and serial execution; no guarantee under other onboard workloads, flight cooling, radiation or power limits
Input normalization truncates uint16 amplitude to uint8; target previews retain full ROI extent but lose native detail at 512x512
Image focusing and source-file decoding remain outside the calibrated boundary
Aggregation is the measured CPU reference on its recorded machine, not an unmeasured production server
No controlled idle or resident-model baseline was recorded; no incremental power or per-task energy is inferred
Finite-run throughput acceptance does not certify GPU clock stability, complete thermal equilibrium or longer-duration behavior
Individual CUDA/RSS budget checks and system RAM observations do not prove a shared-memory simultaneous peak bound

workload_fixture.purpose: Synthetic output-load assumption for timing and scheduling calibration
limitations: Not observed SAR annotations or measured harbor density
Class IDs are arbitrary workload labels, not validated vessel classes
Preview resizing preserves the entire ROI but not native spatial detail
All repeated per-window records are transmitted before ground deduplication
A fixed mean output byte count is a simulator approximation; exact per-window counts remain here

tiling.input_rule: Independent full uint16 windows; duplicated overlap is transmitted
tiling.record_rule: Include only when the outward-rounded OBB ROI plus context fits completely

output_encoding.preview_rule: Extract complete local ROI; aspect-preserving resize and zero letterbox to 512x512; no compression
output_encoding.coordinate_convention: Local xy pixels, integer ROI upper bounds exclusive

transport.compression_assumption: Uncompressed/compressed size ratio; fixed modeling assumption, not measured codec performance
transport.inference_rule: bands/bits_per_sample define model input and VRAM proxy, independently of native transport
transport.compute_rule: Calibrated uint16 amplitude normalization, replicated three-channel 4096 input, FP32 network forward, controlled polygon NMS and target-preview encoding; SAR focusing is upstream and original file decoding is excluded

ready_arrival_summary.scope: Fixed UTC clock hours for all five targets together; not each target or every rolling hour

densest_300s.interval_rule: [start_s, start_s+300); ties at same instant all count

architecture.choice_reason: Smallest audited group with both every clock hour represented and longest ready gap below one hour

parameter_basis.image_product: ICEYE Spot Fine reference: nominal 5x5 km, 0.5 m resolution, 0.25 m pixel spacing, uint16 amplitude; exact square raster is a modeling choice
parameter_basis.uniform_compute_basis: User-selected equal service rate and one serial slot for every SAR source, compute satellite and ground node; Jetson reference, not a ground-server performance claim
parameter_basis.ready_delay_basis: Fixed upstream image-formation delay assumption; shifts release times, does not consume modeled inference resources; P300 starts afterwards

memory.basis: Separate logical budgets within shared memory, not independent physical RAM and VRAM; decimal GB

links.basis: Cross-mission equipment-reference combination, not an actual ICEYE network; ideal payload efficiency and zero acquisition overhead

execution_limits: One serial inference slot per satellite and ground station; work-conserving service with step-end completion events
Distributed input queues materialize overlapping windows: 2.147483648 GB per image; the 8 GB queue fits three complete unprocessed images, not ten 800 MB shared views
Aggregation is a fixed delay without a shared aggregation queue; ground RAM/VRAM admission is not implemented
At 10 Gbps the input window needs 0.0268435456 seconds ideally; dt=0.1 rounds hop completion to step boundaries, requiring a finer-step check before algorithm ranking claims
Topology and ground visibility update every 10 seconds; contact predictions scan every 30 seconds; geometry is an optimistic screen
Ground site and its single aggregate receiving channel are research assumptions
No independent energy, pointing, SAR duty-cycle, image focusing, or thermal-flight constraints
Per-window mean result bytes are fixed at arrival; test-image detections are not leaked into scheduling
Full original-image delivery within the same SLA is not implemented by this protocol
Only one 24-hour development day; multi-day held-out evaluation waits for method freezing
